    highlight: tango

  .report-header { background-color: #2c3e50; color: white; padding: 20px; border-radius: 5px; }
  .metric-box { border: 1px solid #dee2e6; padding: 15px; border-radius: 5px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
</style>

<div class="report-header">
  # Sample: `r params$sample_data$Sample`
</div>

### 1. Genomic Assembly Quality
<div class="metric-box">
* **Assembly Length:** `r format(params$sample_data$Total_Bases, big.mark=",")` bp
* **N50:** `r params$sample_data$N50`
* **Number of Contigs:** `r params$sample_data$Contig_Num`
</div>

### 2. Genotypic Features
<div class="metric-box">
* **EMM Type:** `r params$sample_data$emm_Type`
* **MLST (ST):** `r params$sample_data$ST`
</div>

<hr>
*Report generated on: `r Sys.Date()`*
